facts.mash_bill: Botanicals: angelica, caraway, chamomile, coriander, cubeb, elderflower, juniper, lemon, orange, orris, yarrow; plus rose and cucumber essences added after distillation
facts.cask: Carter-head still and pot (Bennett) still distillates blended

notes: Producer site behind age gate; no producer notes. facts.cask holds still info (gin is unaged); botanical list from The Gin Is In.

producer.nose: Ripe fruit, candied orange and light juniper; apple, watermelon, mango, peach, dried banana, sugared almond and light toasted oak.
producer.palate: Creamy and viscous; fresh fruit with vanilla ice cream and toasted oak, gentle earthy spice.
producer.finish: Lingering tropical fruit; oaky vanilla fades to grilled pineapple and mango with coriander, candied orange, juniper and cassia.
producer.summary: Bruichladdich gin with 22 hand-foraged Islay botanicals, matured at least 3 years in oak.

critics.nose: Earthy, peppery and woody with cardamom, florals and orange slices.
critics.palate: Candied orange, toffee, pepper, spicy oak and vanilla with subtle juniper.
critics.finish: Subtle mixed spice and pepper.
critics.summary: Reviewed alongside the younger Cask Rested gin; Cask Aged is the 3+ year, 46% release.

critics.palate: Prominent wood with vanilla sweetness and a distinctive grilled pineapple note.
critics.summary: Well balanced between gin and brown spirit. Reviewed at 46%.

facts.mash_bill: Gin with 22 wild Islay botanicals
facts.cask: Blend of oak casks incl. bourbon, Amarone, Sauternes, Pauillac, rum and St. Emilion
